spec_features.spec_quote: empty tool_call list terminates the episode early
spec_features.evidence: runner.py:82-85 `if not comp.tool_calls: record.turns.append(assistant_turn); record.metadata["termination"] = "no_tool_calls"; break` — actually breaks the per-turn loop, ending the episode.
spec_features.notes: Enforced end-to-end. Fires when the model emits no tool calls (e.g., gives up in-channel), stopping further turns.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # If there are no tool calls, the model has given up / finished in-channel

spec_features.spec_quote: Timeouts are wall-clock (`config.TIMEOUT_SECONDS`) to prevent runaway API spend
spec_features.evidence: runner.py:127-129 `if time.time() - start_time > config.TIMEOUT_SECONDS: record.metadata["termination"] = "timeout"; break`; TIMEOUT_SECONDS=120 at config.py:15. start_time set at runner.py and compared each turn.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely checked and breaks the loop. Only checked after a completed turn (not mid-completion), but it does change execution and stop the episode.

spec_features.evidence: config.py:14 `MAX_TURNS = 20`; runner.py:61 `for turn_idx in range(max_turns)` (default config.MAX_TURNS) with `else: record.metadata["termination"] = "max_turns"`. Each task's check_terminal (task_variants.py, e.g. `return state.turns_taken >= 20`) is also checked at runner.py:62-63 and breaks.
spec_features.notes: Cap enforced two ways: the bounded range() loop and per-task check_terminal >= 20.
